problem_contract.desired: find a low-turnover FX-specific gross entry edge whose expected move can survive observed BID/ASK costs
problem_contract.as_is: V21 had negative proposal-level gross edge; V22 and V23 exit-only variants reduced or changed turnover but remained negative under adverse cost
problem_contract.gap: the prior families reacted to rolling bars without a fixed session auction structure capable of concentrating edge per decision
problem_contract.fact: V23 used 158 walk auxiliary events and 49 actual exits but produced base 0.9983839638 and adverse 0.9905174416
problem_contract.hypothesis: a first failed break of a fully completed Asian-session box during the European morning concentrates stop-sweep reversal behavior into at most one decision per pair per UTC day
problem_contract.counter_hypothesis: the Asian box has no stable reversal edge in this corpus, or the executable spread consumes the gross move
problem_contract.minimum_test: one fixed session definition, first unambiguous reclaim only, same three cost arms, and same seven-pair fixed allocation
problem_contract.stop_condition: reject if proposal gross edge is nonpositive, base/adverse standalone months fail, or density falls below 20 signals per standalone month

single_changed_variable: replace prior rolling signal families with a fixed UTC Asian-box first-sweep reclaim entry

indicator.name: Asian Box Sweep Reclaim
indicator.box: all 72 contiguous completed M5 bars with timestamps 00:00 through 05:55 UTC
indicator.box_high: maximum completed mid high in the box
indicator.box_low: minimum completed mid low in the box
indicator.observation_window: completed M5 bars with timestamps 06:00 through 11:55 UTC
indicator.long: the first observation bar trades strictly below box_low, does not also trade above box_high, and closes strictly back above box_low
indicator.short: the first observation bar trades strictly above box_high, does not also trade below box_low, and closes strictly back below box_high
indicator.entry: the following M5 executable BID/ASK open
indicator.exit: the completed close of the 15:55 UTC M5 bar, corresponding to 16:00 UTC
indicator.maximum_signals: one per pair per UTC day

evaluation.signal_identity: the exact same signal_id, entry, direction, and exit are used by all arms
evaluation.inventory: one position per pair; no add, no martingale, no overlap across UTC days, finite same-day exit
evaluation.allocation: seven fixed 1/7 sleeves; gross cap 1.0; no leverage tuning

development_admission: at least 20 source signals in the full walk and each standalone month
proposal-level mean gross return is strictly positive in the full walk and each standalone month
normal and adverse equity multiples exceed 1.0 in the full walk and each standalone month
multiplicity: Count V24 as the first hypothesis in the FX session-auction family.
